title: Docket day plan: a repeating task (an item of prioritizer.dayplan/recurring v1)

repeat.description: How it repeats. Missing means sprint (items saved before repeat existed).

dueDay.description: repeat sprint: the sprint day it is due on (the last working day if the sprint is shorter).

last.description: Due on the last working day instead of dueDay.

weekday.description: repeat weekly: the day of the week, 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday.

at.description: Optional time the task is for, 24-hour HH:MM (shown on a 12-hour clock). Plans it into the block on at that time.

made.description: Start dates of sprints (repeat sprint) or the days (the rest) that already got their task.

planKind.description: Automatic Day planning: the block kind its task goes into on its due day; empty means don't plan.

from.description: The app (and its record) this item was accepted from, so that app's later offers update it instead of adding another.
